title.zh: 矩阵中 1 的最大数量

desc.zh: 按 (行 mod s, 列 mod s) 把格子分成 s² 类：任何 s×s 窗口里每类恰好一格，所以挑 k 个最大的类整类填 1。
desc.en: Group cells by (row mod s, column mod s): every s×s window holds exactly one cell of each class, so fill the k largest classes.

complexity: O(s² log s) time for s = sideLength (sorting s² class sizes); O(s²) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Residue classes of a sliding window
concepts.description: Every s×s window contains exactly one cell with each (row mod s, column mod s), so filling a whole class costs one per window.

concepts.name: Counting a residue class
concepts.description: Class (a, b) has ceil((height − a) / s) · ceil((width − b) / s) cells; take the k largest.

concepts.name: Averaging over windows as an upper bound
concepts.description: A weighted random window covers each cell with probability 1 / its class size, which caps every valid grid at the top-k sum.
